A '''mountain''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qalydon/Legends|Qalydon]] was one of a series of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] on the planet, but the mountain was unique among the peaks in the region in that it did not feature rock walls built by the natives throughout their progression as a culture.<ref name="TOR" />
